description:
Split `Filament.Renderer.render_vnode/2` into substrate-only and web-only halves; this ticket is the substrate-only half.

The substrate walker recursively visits a vnode tree, registers child fibers via `:component` nodes (calling `render_component_child/3` or `render_component_child_keyed/4`), and recurses into `:element` and `:fragment` children. It returns a vnode tree (potentially with rewritten `:component` nodes carrying child rendered output as a sub-vnode-tree — design call for the implementer).

After this ticket, the substrate walker emits no HTML iodata, no `phx-event` attribute strings, no escape calls. Those concerns move to the web converter in flm-3wr.1.4.

## Files

- `lib/filament/renderer.ex` — split `render_vnode/2`; remove web bits from substrate path.
- Existing tests for the walker should pass against the new shape.

## Acceptance

- Substrate walker returns a vnode tree, not iodata.
- Side effects (fiber registration via `render_component_child*`) happen during the walk.
- All existing renderer/reconciler tests pass.
- Add tests for `:fragment` recursion and keyed/non-keyed `:component` registration if missing.
title: Phase 1.1: substrate vnode walker
